/* Block comment */
type shape =
  | Circle(float)
  | Rect(float, float)

let area = shape =>
  switch shape {
  | Circle(r) => 3.14 *. r *. r
  | Rect(w, h) => w *. h
  }

@react.component
let make = (~name: string) => {
  let greeting = `Hello, ${name}! Count: ${Int.toString(0x1F)}`
  let opt = Some(42)
  switch opt {
  | Some(n) if n > 0 => Console.log(greeting)
  | _ => ()
  }
  <div> {React.string("hi")} </div>
}

let rec fib = n => n < 2 ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
